content: Timoteo Lɛ́yɛ́tsɩá Paulo Mʋa Silastɔ
Paulo mʋa Silas bɛnatɩ́ yɔ́ Derbe pʋ́ Listra. Ohógyipʋ ɔkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Timoteo bʋ Listra wúlutɔ ɩnʋ. Mʋ yin gyí Yudayin ánɩ́ ɔlɔhɔ Yesu gyi, támɛ mʋ sɩ gyí Griikiyin.
Apíó ánɩ́ bʋbʋ Listra pʋ́ Ikonion bɛtɩ Timoteo ɩdayilé.
Paulo lékléá ɔbɛ́kpa Timoteo nátɩ́. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛha bɛtɩn Timoteo keté, tsúfɛ́ Yudafɔ ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋbʋ ɩnʋ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bʋyin ánɩ́ Griikiyin Timoteo mʋ sɩ gyí.
Brɛ́á bɔyɔ́ á, bowíé wúlugyíwúlusʋ bʋtosúná ɩnʋ ahógyipʋ mbla oduá Yesu sumbí ayɔpʋ́ ámʋ pʋ́ ɔpasua ahandɛ amʋ́ʋ́ bʋbʋ Yerusalem amʋ bawá bɛɛ bʋgyíi mʋ́sʋ́.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔpasua ámʋ benya ɔwʋnlɩ́n hógyitɔ, klɛ́ɩ́ ekekegyíɛkɛ.
Paulo Makedonia Ɔmátɔ́ Yɔ
Paulo mʋa mʋ aba ámʋ bɔtsʋn Frigia pʋ́ Galatia ɔmásʋ́. Tsúfɛ́ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ mɛ́ha amʋ́ ɔkpa ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋdáa Bulu asʋ́n ámʋ ɔkan Asia ɔmátɔ́.
Brɛ́á bowie Misia ɔsʋlʋ́ʋ ɔka á, bɔbwɛ agywɩɩn bɛɛ béyinkí tsʋn yɔ Bitinia ɔmátɔ́, támɛ Yesu Ɔŋɛ́ mɛha amʋ́ ɔkpa.
Mʋ́ sʋ bɔtsʋn Misia ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ kplɩ́ yɔ́ Troa wúlutɔ.
Mʋ́ onyé á, Paulo lówun atɔ́. Olowun ánɩ́ Makedoniayin ɔkʋ lɩ́ɩ́ mʋ ansɩ́tɔ́, ɔdɛ mʋ kokóli ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fa ɔpʋ amʋ ba Makedonia, afʋbegyi anɩ bʋalɛ.”
Paulo lénya wun atɔ́ ámʋ alɩ, ɩlɔwankɩ́ mʋ ánɩ́ Bulu dɛ́ anɩ wa ɔbɛ́ɛ, ayɔ́ yɛda asʋn wankláán ámʋ ɔkan ɩnʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ anɩlɔ́pʋ ɔkpa yɔ́ Makedonia.
Lidia Klʋntɔdamlí Filipi Wúlutɔ
Anɩlówie ntsusʋ-yibitɔ tsú Troa, fá ɔpʋ yɔ́ Samotrake ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ. Mʋ́ ɔyɩ kɛhɛ a, anɩlɛ́latsíá yɔ́ Neapoli wúlutɔ.
Anɩlɔ́pʋ ayabitɔ tsú Neapoli yɔ́ Filipi wúlutɔ. Filipi gyí Makedonia wúlu yilé nɩ́. Romafɔ bʋ́ʋ wúlu anfɩtɔ. Anɩlétsiá ɩnʋ nkɛ kpalobí.
Ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́ á, anɩlɛ́dalɩ wúlutɔ yɔ́ ɔpʋ ɔnɔ́ ɔtɩnɛkʋá anɩkɩ́ anɩaa, abówun ɔtɩ́nɛ́á Yudafɔ bʋtefia bɔ mpáɩ. Anɩlétsiá ɩnʋ bláa atsɩ akʋá bebefia ɩnʋ Bulu asʋ́n.
Atsɩá bonu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ ɔkʋlɛ gyí Lidia. Tiatirayin ogyi, ɔtɛfɛ́ tatiá mʋ́ ntsu lɛpɛ, ɩbʋ bíá. Bulu osúmpʋ́ ogyi. Anɩ Wíe lɛ́ha mʋ olonu Paulo asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ amʋtɔ.

Mʋ́ sʋ brɛ́á anɩlɔ́bɔ mʋa mʋ wóyítɔ́ ahá asú á, olobwií ɩpa há anɩ, blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ mlɩlahogyi ánɩ́ nahɔ Yesu gyi a, mlɩbetsiá mɩ́ wóyítɔ́.” Ɔtsɩ ánfɩ bʋ anɩsʋ alɩɩ anɩlóbuo mʋ yɔ́ mʋ wóyítɔ́.
Paulo Mʋa Silas Obudɩ Filipi
Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ ayɔ́ Yudafɔ mpáɩ ɔbɔkpá ɩnʋ á, anɩlɔ́tʋ otsibi ɔkʋá ogyi ɔkpábi ɩnʋ. Atɔ́la ɔŋɛ́ bʋ mʋsʋ, ɔtɛlá atɔ́, blɩ́ asʋ́n ánɩ́ ɩbɛ́ba. Ɔtɔbwɛ́ kɔ́ba tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ há mʋ awíe tsú mʋ́tɔ́.
Otsibi anfɩ lɛ́kplá buo anɩa Paulonyɔ. Ɔna ɔdɛkplʋ́n blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ahá ánfɩ gyí Ɔsʋ́sʋ́ʋ́sʋ́ Bulu ámʋ asúmpʋ́ nɩ. Amʋ́dɛ́ mlɩ nkpahɔ́ɔ ɔkpa suná nɩ́.”
Ɔlɔbwɛ mʋ́ nkɛ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ. Ɩ́nɩ lɛhan Paulo. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛdamlí bláa otsibi amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Atɔ́la ɔŋɛ́, ndɛ mbla wa há fʋ́ Yesu Kristo dátɔ́, dalɩ mʋtɔ!” Ɩnʋnʋ ɔŋɛ́ ámʋ lɛ́dalɩ mʋtɔ.
Ɔkpábi amʋ awíe bowun ánɩ́ amʋ́ kɔ́ba ɔkpa latin. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛkɩtá Paulo mʋa Silas, bɩ́tɩ́a amʋ́ ya wúlu ahandɛ ansɩ́tɔ́.
Bɔpʋ amʋ́ ya Romafɔ asʋ́n agyípʋ́ bɛɛ, “Yudafɔ ahá ánfɩ bʋgyi, bʋdɛ asʋ́n klée wa anɩ wúlu anfɩtɔ.
Bʋdɛ amándɩ́ɛ́ laláhɛ ánɩ́ anɩ mbla mɛha mʋ́ ɩwɩ ɔkpa suná. Romafɔ anɩ mʋ́ anɩgyí. Anɩmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ hɔ amʋ́ amándɩ́ɛ́ ámʋ gyi mʋ́sʋ́.”
Ɩnʋ ɔdɔm amʋ botu bun Paulo mʋa Silasʋ. Asʋ́n agyípʋ́ amʋ bɛha bɛɛ bʋwɔ́ɩ amʋ́ atadɩɛ, abʋnwɛn amʋ́ mplɩ.
Bɛpɩtɩ́ Paulo mʋa Silas atɔ́ wankláán tá á, bɛha bɔpʋ amʋ́ tswɩ obu. Bɛbláa obu adɩpʋ́sʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ bɛɛ, ogyóo amʋ́ wankláán.
Asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ bɛbláa obu adɩpʋ́sʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ amʋ sʋ ɔlɔpʋ amʋ́ yɛ́tswɩ obutótɔ́, wá amʋ́ ayabi kplakitsi.
Obu Adɩpʋ́sʋ́ Ɔkɩ́pʋ Yesu Hógyi
Mʋ́ ɔyɩ́-nsɩnɛ́ á, Paulo mʋa Silas bʋdɛ mpáɩ bɔ, bʋdɛ ɩlʋ wa kánfʋ́ Bulu. Obu adɩpʋ́ atráhɛ amʋ ɛ́ bʋda bʋdenu.
Ɔtsáwʋlɛ pɛ́ á, ɔsʋlʋ́ʋ lɛ́kpɩnkɩ́ ɔwʋnlɩ́nsʋ́, ɩlɛkpɩnkɩ́ obu ámʋ ntswɩasɩ. Mʋ́ aklʋn fɛ́ɛ́ lefinkí. Obu adɩpʋ́ ámʋ ɩkan pʋ́ amʋ́ kplakitsi amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ lɔwɔɩ́.
Obu adɩpʋ́sʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ amʋ létsinkí, wun ánɩ́ aklʋn amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ lafínkí. Ɩnʋ ɔlɛlɛ ɔdayí ɩya anyɔ ɔbɛ́ɛ amʋwɔ ɩwɩ, tsúfɛ́ ɔkɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ obu adɩpʋ́ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ badálɩ srɩ́.
Támɛ Paulo lɔ́kplʋn kʋ́klʋ́kʋ́ʋ́ bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mábwɛ ɩwɩ tɔtɔ. Anɩ fɛ́ɛ́ anɩbʋ ɩnʋ.”
Obu adɩpʋ́sʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ amʋ lɛ́ha botsu ɔkandɩ́ɛ ba mʋ, ɔlɔwa ɔsa wíé obu ámʋtɔ. Ifú dɛ mʋ, sʋ ɔdɛkpɩnkɩ́ kpakpakpakpa. Ɔlɛyɛ́da akpawunu Paulo mʋa Silas ayabitɔ.
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛkpa amʋ́ dálɩ yɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ awíé, ntɔ mbwɛ́ɛ asa Bulu ɔhɔ mɩ nkpa?”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Paulo mʋa Silas bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Hɔ Yesu gyi, mɛ́nɩ Bulu ɔbɔ́hɔ fʋ́a fʋ́ wóyítɔ́ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ nkpa.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ bɛbláa mʋa mʋ wóyítɔ́ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ anɩ Wíe Yesu asʋn wankláán ámʋ.
Onyé-onyé ámʋ a, oyin ámʋ léyiá amʋ́ ɩwɩ nlɔ ámʋ́ʋ́ benya brɛ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ bɛpɩtɩ́ amʋ́ atɔ́ ámʋ. Ɔlɛha amʋ́ bɔbɔ mʋa mʋ wóyítɔ́ ahá ámʋ asú ɩnʋnʋ.
Obu adɩpʋ́sʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ anfɩ lɔ́pʋ amʋ́ ya mʋ wóyítɔ́, ɔlɛyɛ́ha bɛnɩná atɔ́ há amʋ́ begyi. Ɩ́nɩá mʋa mʋ wóyítɔ́ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ bahɔ Bulu gyi sʋ á, ansɩ́ lɛhɩɛ gyi amʋ́.
Mʋ́ ɔyɩ kɛhɛ a, asʋ́n agyípʋ́ amʋ bɔwa ahá akɩtápʋ́ akʋ bɛɛ bʋyɛ́bláa obu adɩpʋ́sʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ amʋ bɛɛ, osíi ahá ámʋ abʋnatɩ.
Mʋ́ sʋ oyin ámʋ lɛ́bláa Paulo ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Asʋ́n agyípʋ́ amʋ bapʋ́ ɔmɛ sɩ́sɩ́ mɩ́ bɛɛ, nsíi fʋ́a Silas amlɩnatɩ. Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩnatɩ iwilwiitɔ.”

Támɛ Paulo lɛ́bláa ahá akɩtápʋ́ amʋ akʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bʋmegyi anɩ asʋ́n, támɛ banwɛ́n anɩ atɔ́ ɔbʋntɔ. Romafɔ anɩgyí, támɛ bawá anɩ obu. Ntogyi sʋ bʋdekléá bési anɩ ŋáintɔ? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Asʋ́n agyípʋ́ amʋ onutó bʋbá bɛlɛ anɩ.”
Ahá akɩtápʋ́ amʋ beyinkí yɔ́ yɛ́bláa asʋ́n agyípʋ́ amʋ. Brɛ́á bonu ánɩ́ Romafɔ Paulo mʋa Silas bʋgyi á, ifú lɛhɩɛ́ kɩ́tá amʋ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ boyóbwií ɩpa há Paulo aná, bɛkpa amʋ́ dalɩ yókokóli amʋ́ bɛɛ bʋdálɩ wúlu amʋtɔ.
Ɩnʋ Paulo mʋa Silas bɛnatɩ́ yɔ́ Lidia wóyítɔ́. Befia apíó ahógyipʋ amʋ ɩnʋ, tɔɩ́ kplá amʋ́, wá amʋ́ ɔwʋnlɩ́n asa bɛnatɩ́.
